svg.text: Three different VPN questions, and the one most apps are really asking
Reach for this chapter when your app needs to configure a VPN, not when it needs to know about one. Those are
different questions with different answers, and the cheapest of them is not in this chapter at all.
Know whether traffic is going over a VPN
Warn about it, or refuse to run behind one. Answered for years, on far more platforms than can
install a profile, and it needs no entitlement at all. Most apps that reach for this chapter want this.
Configure a VPN the platform runs
Install a managed IKEv2 profile, connect, disconnect, watch the status, set always-on. This is what
a request for a connect to VPN button usually means. Branch on Vpn.isSupported and getCapabilities.
Receive the raw IP packets yourself
Your own loop decides what happens to each packet. Android needs no configuration; iOS needs a build
hint and an entitlement Apple grants case by case. Branch on Tunnels.isSupported.
Branch on the capability rather than the platform, and note the whole package answers nothing on JavaScript.
Every callback arrives on the EDT, so none of this needs marshalling back.
